summary.text: Mike Robinson is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Robinson earned a high school diploma from Brooke High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an executive.

He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary for District 3 with 783 votes in a race with no other Democrat, and he faces incumbent Republican Jimmy Willis and independent Dave Cantrell in the general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Robinson said his campaign is about restoring community values in the northern panhandle, and he named public school teachers, seniors and a new generation of legislators as key messages.
He listed public education, seniors, unions, taxes, health care, SNAP benefits and access to addiction and mental health resources among his policy interests.
